title: Conversion to a three-query satisfiability tester
statement: Given an $n$-dimensional three-query linear sign tester, form a tester whose random seed consists of a seed of the original tester together with a uniformly chosen element of a four-element set. For each such pair, its check uses the original three queries and the three-query satisfiability clause determined by the original seed’s right-hand-side sign and the chosen element.
